english.app[content][about]: [h2 align="center"][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/page_1_heading_eng"][/img][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/bladehold_ultimates_steampagedescription"][/img][/p][p]Agile ranger with sword and bow? Mounted knight to trample your foes? Raging berserker bathing in a bloody bladestorm? Mix and match to become your own custom flavor of destruction.[/p][h2 align="center"][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/steampageheading_eng__2"][/img][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/bladehold_elements_steampagedescription"][/img][/h2][p]Choose game-changing boons each run to infuse your weapons with Fire, Ice, and Lightning. Combine synergies to create devastating chain reactions and melt entire waves in seconds.[/p][h2 align="center"][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/steampageheading_eng__3"][/img][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/bladehold_bannersnav_steampagedescription"][/img][/p][p]Strategically choose where to defend and which enemy captains to provoke.[/p][h2 align="center"][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/steampageheading_eng__4"][/img][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/bladehold_restmeta_steampagedescription"][/img][/p][p]Take some time to restock and gather yourself before heading back out to battle.[/p][h2 align="center"][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/steampageheading_eng__5"][/img][/h2][p]Harvest resources from fallen hordes to unlock permanent character attributes, stronger defensive armaments, and new starting gear back at the stronghold.[/p][h2 align="center"][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/page_6_heading_eng"][/img][/h2][p]Each weapon comes with its own set of upgrades and abilities, making each run equally fresh and rewarding.[/p][h2 align="center"][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/page_7_heading_eng"][/img][/h2][p]Fortify your stronghold with deadly stationary defenses. Deploy arrow towers, boiling oil, ballistas, and spiked barricades to shred invading hordes while you hunt down high-threat commanders.[/p][h2 align="center"][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/page_8_heading_eng"][/img][/h2][p]Hold the front line against relentless enemy hordes threatening to breach your gates with siege weapons and boulder hurling trolls.[/p][h2 align="center"][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/steampageheading_eng__7"][/img][/h2][p]Kill enough enemies to lure out one of the Warlords who will put your skills to the test with special attacks and abilities.[/p][p][/p][h2][/h2]
english.app[content][short_description]: Demolish monstrous hordes on horseback or foot, unleash devastating abilities, build the ultimate hero, and protect your fortress with deadly automated defenses in this fast-paced action roguelite.

french.app[content][about]: [h2 align="center"][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/combatyourway"][/img][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/bladehold_ultimates_steampagedescription"][/img][/p][p]Un rôdeur avec une épée et un arc ? Un chevalier à monture pour terrasser tes ennemis ? Un berserker enragé baignant dans une tempête de lames sanglante ? Mélange et combine pour créer ton propre goût personnalisé de destruction.[/p][p][/p][h2 align="center"][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/elementalbuildcrafting"][/img][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/bladehold_elements_steampagedescription"][/img][/p][p]Choisis tes bénédictions pour retourner la situation à chaque run et infuser tes armes avec du feu, de la glace ou de la foudre. Combine des synergies pour créer des réactions en chaîne dévastatrices et faire fondre des vagues d'ennemis en quelques secondes.[/p][p][/p][h2 align="center"][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/gamedefiningdecisions"][/img][/h2][h2][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/bladehold_bannersnav_steampagedescription"][/img][/h2][p]Choisis stratégiquement où défendre et quels capitaines ennemis provoquer.[/p][p][/p][h2 align="center"][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/restandrecover"][/img][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/bladehold_restmeta_steampagedescription"][/img][/p][p]Prends du temps pour te restocker et te ressourcer avant de retourner au combat.[/p][p][/p][h2 align="center"][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/endlessprogression"][/img][/h2][p][/p][p]Récolte des ressources sur les hordes tombées au combat pour débloquer des attributs permanents pour ton héros, un meilleur armement défensif et un meilleur équipement de départ au bastion.[/p][p][/p][h2 align="center"][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/uniqueweaponabilities"][/img][/h2][p][/p][p]Chaque arme a son propre set d'améliorations et de compétences, rendant chaque run unique et récompensant.[/p][p][/p][h2 align="center"][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/automateddefensestraps"][/img][/h2][p][/p][p]Fortifie ton bastion avec des défenses létales stationnaires. Déploie de l'huile bouillante, des balistes et des barricades de pics pour détruire des hordes d'envahisseurs pendant la traque de dangereux commandants.[/p][p][/p][h2 align="center"][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/thefortressundersiege"][/img][/h2][p][/p][p]Repousse tes ennemis en première ligne face à des hordes d'ennemis impitoyables qui menacent de détruire tes portes avec des armes de siège et des trolls lanceurs de rochers.[/p][p][/p][h2 align="center"][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/challengingbosses"][/img][/h2][p][/p][p]Tue assez d'ennemis pour attirer l'un des chefs de guerre, qui mettra tes compétences à l'épreuve avec des attaques spéciales et des capacités.[/p]
french.app[content][short_description]: Annihile des hordes monstrueuses a pied ou à cheval, déchaîne des capacités dévastatrices, construit l'héro ultime et protège ta forteresse grâce a des défenses létales automatisées dans ce roguelike d'action effréné.

italian.app[content][about]: [h2 align="center"][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/combatyourway"][/img][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/bladehold_ultimates_steampagedescription"][/img][/p][p]Ranger agile con spada e arco? Cavaliere in sella pronto a travolgere i nemici? O berserker furioso immerso in una tempesta di lame sanguinaria? Combina gli stili e crea la tua ricetta personale di distruzione.[/p][p][/p][h2 align="center"][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/elementalbuildcrafting"][/img][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/bladehold_elements_steampagedescription"][/img][/p][p]A ogni run, scegli doni rivoluzionari per infondere le tue armi con Fuoco, Ghiaccio e Fulmine. Sfrutta le sinergie per innescare reazioni a catena devastanti e sciogliere intere ondate in pochi secondi.[/p][p][/p][h2 align="center"][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/gamedefiningdecisions"][/img][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/bladehold_bannersnav_steampagedescription"][/img][/p][p]Scegli con astuzia dove piazzare le difese e quali capitani nemici provocare.[/p][p][/p][h2 align="center"][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/restandrecover"][/img][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/bladehold_restmeta_steampagedescription"][/img][/p][p]Prenditi una pausa per fare rifornimento e riordinare le idee prima di ributtarti nella mischia.[/p][p][/p][h2 align="center"][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/endlessprogression"][/img][/h2][p]Raccogli le risorse lasciate dai nemici sconfitti per sbloccare attributi permanenti per il personaggio, armamenti difensivi più potenti e nuovo equipaggiamento di partenza una volta tornato alla fortezza.[/p][p][/p][h2 align="center"][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/uniqueweaponabilities"][/img][/h2][p]Ogni arma include un proprio set di potenziamenti e abilità, rendendo ogni run sempre nuova e appagante.[/p][p][/p][h2 align="center"][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/automateddefensestraps"][/img][/h2][p]Rinforza la tua roccaforte con letali difese fisse. Schiera olio bollente, baliste e barricate chiodate per fare a pezzi le orde d'invasione mentre dai la caccia ai comandanti più pericolosi.[/p][p][/p][h2 align="center"][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/thefortressundersiege"][/img][/h2][p]Difendi la prima linea contro orde inarrestabili pronte a sfondare i tuoi cancelli con macchine d'assedio e troll lancia-macigni.[/p][p][/p][h2 align="center"][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/challengingbosses"][/img][/h2][p]Elimina abbastanza nemici per attirare allo scoperto uno dei Signori della Guerra, pronto a mettere a dura prova i tuoi riflessi con abilità e attacchi speciali.[/p][p][/p]

german.app[content][about]: [h2 align="center"][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/combatyourway"][/img][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/bladehold_ultimates_steampagedescription"][/img][/p][p]Flinker Waldläufer mit Schwert und Bogen? Ritter hoch zu Ross, der seine Feinde niederreitet? Oder rasender Berserker im blutigen Klingensturm? Kombiniere nach Lust und Laune und erschaffe deine ganz eigene Spielart der Zerstörung.[/p][p][/p][h2 align="center"][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/elementalbuildcrafting"][/img][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/bladehold_elements_steampagedescription"][/img][/p][p]Wähle in jedem Run Segen, die das Spiel auf den Kopf stellen, und verstärke deine Waffen mit Feuer, Eis und Blitz. Löse mit den richtigen Synergien verheerende Kettenreaktionen aus und lass ganze Gegnerwellen in Sekunden dahinschmelzen.[/p][p][/p][h2 align="center"][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/gamedefiningdecisions"][/img][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/bladehold_bannersnav_steampagedescription"][/img][/p][p]Plane klug voraus, wo du die Stellung hältst und welchen feindlichen Hauptmann du dir vorknöpfst.[/p][p][/p][h2 align="center"][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/restandrecover"][/img][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/bladehold_restmeta_steampagedescription"][/img][/p][p]Füll deine Vorräte auf und sammle neue Kraft, bevor es zurück in die Schlacht geht.[/p][p][/p][h2 align="center"][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/endlessprogression"][/img][/h2][p]Plündere die gefallenen Horden und schalte in deiner Festung dauerhafte Heldenattribute, stärkere Verteidigungswaffen und neue Startausrüstung frei.[/p][p][/p][h2 align="center"][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/uniqueweaponabilities"][/img][/h2][p]Jede Waffe bringt ihre eigenen Upgrades und Fähigkeiten mit. So fühlt sich jeder Run frisch an und belohnt aufs Neue.[/p][p][/p][h2 align="center"][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/automateddefensestraps"][/img][/h2][p]Rüste deine Festung mit tödlichen Abwehranlagen auf. Kochendes Öl, Ballisten und Stachelbarrikaden zerfetzen die anstürmenden Horden, während du selbst Jagd auf die gefährlichsten Kommandanten machst.[/p][p][/p][h2 align="center"][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/thefortressundersiege"][/img][/h2][p]Halte die Front gegen unerbittliche Horden, die mit Belagerungsgerät und Felsen schleudernden Trollen deine Tore einreißen wollen.[/p][p][/p][h2 align="center"][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/challengingbosses"][/img][/h2][p]Erledige genug Gegner und einer der Kriegsherren betritt das Schlachtfeld. Mit seinen Spezialangriffen und Fähigkeiten verlangt er dir alles ab.[/p]
german.app[content][short_description]: Zu Pferd oder zu Fuß: Mähe ganze Monsterhorden nieder, entfessle verheerende Fähigkeiten, baue deinen ultimativen Helden und verwandle deine Festung mit automatischen Abwehranlagen in eine Todesfalle. Ein rasantes Action-Roguelite.

spanish.app[content][about]: [h2 align="center"][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/combatyourway"][/img][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/bladehold_ultimates_steampagedescription"][/img][/p][p]¿Un ágil explorador con espada y arco? ¿Un soldado a caballo para aplastar a tus enemigos? ¿Un furioso berserker envuelto en una sangrienta tormenta de acero? Combina diferentes formas de luchar para crear tu propio estilo de destrucción.[/p][h2 align="center"][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/elementalbuildcrafting"][/img][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/bladehold_elements_steampagedescription"][/img][/p][p]Elige bendiciones que cambien el curso de la partida para imbuir tus armas con fuego, hielo y rayos. Aprovecha las sinergias para crear devastadoras reacciones en cadena y aniquilar oleadas enteras en segundos.[/p][h2 align="center"][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/gamedefiningdecisions"][/img][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/bladehold_bannersnav_steampagedescription"][/img][/p][p]Elige estratégicamente dónde defender y a qué capitanes enemigos atraer.[/p][h2 align="center"][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/restandrecover"][/img][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/bladehold_restmeta_steampagedescription"][/img][/p][p]Tómate un tiempo para reabastecerte y recomponerte antes de volver a la batalla.[/p][h2 align="center"][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/endlessprogression"][/img][/h2][p]Recolecta recursos de las hordas derrotadas para desbloquear atributos permanentes del personaje, armamento defensivo más potente y nuevo equipo inicial en tu bastión.[/p][h2 align="center"][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/uniqueweaponabilities"][/img][/h2][p]Cada arma cuenta con su propio conjunto de mejoras y habilidades, lo que hace que cada partida se sienta fresca y gratificante.[/p][h2 align="center"][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/automateddefensestraps"][/img][/h2][p]Fortalece tu bastión con defensas estáticas letales. Despliega aceite hirviendo, balistas y barricadas con púas para destrozar a las hordas invasoras mientras das caza a los comandantes más peligrosos.[/p][h2 align="center"][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/thefortressundersiege"][/img][/h2][p]Mantén la el frente ante implacables hordas enemigas que amenazan con romper tus puertas usando armas de asedio y troles lanzadores de rocas.[/p][h2 align="center"][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/challengingbosses"][/img][/h2][p]Elimina suficientes enemigos para atraer a uno de los Señores de la Guerra, quienes pondrán a prueba tus habilidades con ataques y capacidades especiales.[/p][p][/p]
spanish.app[content][short_description]: Aniquila hordas de monstruos a caballo o a pie, desata habilidades devastadoras, crea al héroe definitivo y protege tu fortaleza con defensas automatizadas letales en este roguelite de acción trepidante.

japanese.app[content][about]: [h2 align="center"][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/combatyourway"][/img][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/bladehold_ultimates_steampagedescription"][/img][/p][p]剣と弓を操る機敏なレンジャー、敵を踏み潰す騎兵、血の剣雨に身を投じる凶戦士──自由に組み合わせ、自分だけの破壊を組み上げましょう。[/p][p][/p][h2 align="center"][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/elementalbuildcrafting"][/img][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/bladehold_elements_steampagedescription"][/img][/p][p]各ランでバフを選び、武器に「炎」「氷」「雷」を宿しましょう。それらのシナジーで破滅的な連鎖を生み、敵の波を瞬時に一掃できます。[/p][p][/p][h2 align="center"][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/gamedefiningdecisions"][/img][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/bladehold_bannersnav_steampagedescription"][/img][/p][p]どこで守るか、どの敵に挑むか？すべてあなたの戦略次第です。[/p][p][/p][h2 align="center"][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/restandrecover"][/img][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/bladehold_restmeta_steampagedescription"][/img][/p][p]戦いの合間には、息と物資を整えましょう。[/p][p][/p][h2 align="center"][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/endlessprogression"][/img][/h2][p]拠点で、永続的なパワーアップ、より強力な防衛...そして新たな初期装備を、戦利品を用いてアンロックできます。[/p][p][/p][h2 align="center"][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/uniqueweaponabilities"][/img][/h2][p]武器ごとに完全に独自の能力とアップグレードが用意されています。新鮮さと達成感を毎ラン感じられるでしょう。[/p][p][/p][h2 align="center"][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/automateddefensestraps"][/img][/h2][p]拠点を劇的な固定防衛装置で要塞化。熱湯から棘の障壁、バリスタをも駆使して大群を蹂躙し、強敵はあなたの手で。[/p][p][/p][h2 align="center"][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/thefortressundersiege"][/img][/h2][p]トロールたちの投石や攻城兵器の容赦ない敵軍に、門を突破されないよう前線を死守しましょう。[/p][p][/p][h2 align="center"][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/challengingbosses"][/img][/h2][p]多くの敵を倒すとボスが姿を現します。特殊な攻撃・能力であなたの腕を試してきます──。[/p]
japanese.app[content][short_description]: このハイテンポなアクションローグライクで、地上でも馬上でも怪物の群れを殲滅し、圧倒の能力を解放し、究極の英雄を育て、さらに恐るべき自動防衛で要塞を守り抜きましょう。

koreana.app[content][about]: [h2 align="center"][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/combatyourway"][/img][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/bladehold_ultimates_steampagedescription"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]검과 활을 다루는 신출귀몰한 레인저. [/p][p]적을 짓밟는 마상의 기사. [/p][p]피로 검을 물들이는 광폭한 버서커. [/p][p]당신의 빌드로 적들을 파괴하세요.[/p][p][/p][h2 align="center"][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/elementalbuildcrafting"][/img][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/bladehold_elements_steampagedescription"][/img][/p][p]매 라운드마다 무기에 깃드는 불, 얼음, 번개의 속성으로 게임의 판도를 뒤집으세요. [/p][p]파괴적인 속성 시너지를 만든다면, 몰려오는 웨이브를 녹여버릴 수 있습니다.[/p][p][/p][h2 align="center"][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/gamedefiningdecisions"][/img][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/bladehold_bannersnav_steampagedescription"][/img][/p][p]어디서 방어할지, 어떤 적을 상대할지는 당신의 전략에 달려 있습니다.[/p][p][/p][h2 align="center"][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/restandrecover"][/img][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/bladehold_restmeta_steampagedescription"][/img][/p][p]다음 전투가 기다립니다. [/p][p]물자를 보급하고, 전열을 가다듬으세요.[/p][p][/p][h2 align="center"][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/endlessprogression"][/img][/h2][p]적들의 전리품을 수집하여 새로운 캐릭터를 해금하고, 요새 방어 물자와 새로운 스타팅 장비를 획득하세요.[/p][p][/p][h2 align="center"][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/uniqueweaponabilities"][/img][/h2][p]각 무기에는 고유의 업그레이드 트리와 능력들이 담겨 있습니다. [/p][p]매 라운드를 새롭고 보람 있게 만들어 줄 겁니다.[/p][p][/p][h2 align="center"][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/automateddefensestraps"][/img][/h2][p]전선에 방어탑과 바리케이드, 각종 함정을 설치하여 요새로 몰려드는 적들을 갈아버리는 동안 당신의 영웅은 적들의 우두머리를 직접 사냥해야 합니다.[/p][p][/p][h2 align="center"][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/thefortressundersiege"][/img][/h2][p]공성 무기와 바위를 던지는 트롤들이 올 겁니다. [/p][p]당신이 얼마나 버틸 수 있을지 지켜보겠습니다.[/p][p][/p][h2 align="center"][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/challengingbosses"][/img][/h2][p]많은 적들을 처치하면 강력한 워로드 중 하나가 모습을 드러낼 겁니다. [/p][p]당신의 모든 것을 쏟아부어 워로드를 저지하세요.[/p]
koreana.app[content][short_description]: 쏟아지는 괴물들로부터 철벽의 자동 방어 요새를 지켜내는 액션 로그라이트. 최강의 영웅, 파괴적인 능력, 말과 두 발로 쏟아지는 적을 쓸어버리세요.

brazilian.app[content][about]: [h2 align="center"][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/combatyourway"][/img][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/bladehold_ultimates_steampagedescription"][/img][/p][p]Um ranger ágil de espada e arco? Um cavaleiro pronto para atropelar os inimigos? Um berserker furioso mergulhado em uma tempestade sangrenta de lâminas? Combine os elementos do seu jeito para criar seu próprio estilo de destruição.[/p][p][/p][h2 align="center"][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/elementalbuildcrafting"][/img][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/bladehold_elements_steampagedescription"][/img][/p][p]Escolha dádivas revolucionárias em cada partida para infundir suas armas com Fogo, Gelo e Relâmpagos. schinese.app[content][about]: [h2 align="center"][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/combatyourway"][/img][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/bladehold_ultimates_steampagedescription"][/img][/p][p]是手持剑弓、身法飘逸的敏捷游侠？还是骑乘重驹、肆意践踏敌阵的铁骑骑士？亦或是化身嗜血狂怒、卷起漫天剑刃风暴的狂战士？随心搭配流派，化身为独一无二的毁灭化身！[/p][h2 align="center"][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/elementalbuildcrafting"][/img][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/bladehold_elements_steampagedescription"][/img][/p][p]在每一局冒险中抉择扭转战局的强力增益/恩赐，为你的兵刃注入烈焰、寒冰与狂雷。触发强力羁绊协同，引爆毁天灭地的连锁反应，瞬息之间融化整片敌军！[/p][h2 align="center"][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/gamedefiningdecisions"][/img][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/bladehold_bannersnav_steampagedescription"][/img][/p][p]运筹帷幄，审时度势选择防守要地，并决定挑衅诱杀哪位敌方将领[/p][h2 align="center"][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/restandrecover"][/img][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/bladehold_restmeta_steampagedescription"][/img][/p][p]在大战间隙稍作整顿、补充物资并重聚力量，随后再度奔赴沙场[/p][h2 align="center"][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/endlessprogression"][/img][/h2][p]从溃败的怪物身上掠夺海量资源，返回大本营解锁永久角色属性、强化防御武装，调配全新的初始强力装备，为下一次征程蓄力！[/p][h2 align="center"][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/uniqueweaponabilities"][/img][/h2][p]每种武器都拥有独立的升级分支与专属技能。每一次出征，都能为你带来耳目一新的手感与爽快感爆棚的战斗收益。[/p][h2 align="center"][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/automateddefensestraps"][/img][/h2][p]用致命的固定防御工事加固你的大本营。布置滚烫的沸油、重型床弩与尖刺路障，在陷阱绞碎大批杂兵的同时，你集中火力斩杀高危敌方头目！[/p][h2 align="center"][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/thefortressundersiege"][/img][/h2][p]直面如潮水般汹涌的敌军大狂潮！巨石投掷巨魔与攻城重械步步紧逼，誓要砸碎要塞大门——坚守前线，将他们彻底碾碎！[/p][h2 align="center"][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/challengingbosses"][/img][/h2][p]击杀足够的敌军，引出威震一方的敌方军阀！他们身怀独特绝技与狂暴招式，唯有拿出真正的硬实力才能将其彻底终结。[/p][p][/p]
